# Contributing to BeautifulClient

Thank you for your interest in contributing! 🎉

Before opening an issue or pull request, please:

1. **Check existing issues** to avoid duplicates
2. **Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)** for detailed guidelines
3. **Follow the code of conduct** — be respectful and constructive

## Quick Links

- [Report a Bug](https://github.com/MateuszPodeszwa/UglyClient/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- [Request a Feature](https://github.com/MateuszPodeszwa/UglyClient/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
- [Ask a Question](https://github.com/MateuszPodeszwa/UglyClient/issues/new?template=question.md)
- [View Documentation](../README.md)

## Academic Project Notice

This is an academic assignment project. If you're a student:
- Ensure your contribution complies with your institution's academic integrity policies
- Cite this project properly if using it as a reference (see [CITING.md](../CITING.md))
- Get instructor approval before contributing to academic work

## Support the Project

If you find this project helpful, consider supporting it:
- ⭐ Star the repository
- 💖 [Sponsor on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/mateuszpodeszwa)
- 📢 Share with others who might find it useful

Thank you for contributing!
